questions.question: Why is soft iron commonly used as the core material for an electromagnet?

options.text: Because it can be easily magnetized and demagnetized.
options.explanation: This is correct because soft iron's ability to be easily magnetized and demagnetized makes it ideal for use in electromagnets where the magnetic field needs to be switched on and off.

options.explanation: This is incorrect because while cost and weight might be considerations in some applications, they are not the primary reasons soft iron is used in electromagnets.
